tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Who the calling user is: name, email and their linked staff record. Use it to resolve 'I', 'me' or 'my' to a staff name for other tools.

tools.name: get_staffs
tools.description: List staff members with name, title and staff number. Default: active staff only. Use it to browse the team or to find the exact staff name for other tools.

tools.name: find_resources
tools.description: Search rooms/studios (suites), equipment/licenses (resources) and staff by name in one call; results are grouped by type. Call without search to list everything. Use it to find entities and the exact names to pass to other tools.

search.description: Name or partial name. Multiple words: every word must match. Omit to list everything.

staff.description: Only internal or only external staff. Omit for both.

site.description: Only suites whose site name contains this text.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Check when staff, rooms (suites) or resources are FREE in a date window (default 14 days, max 92). Considers bookings, public holidays and staff absences/work times. Returns free time slots and fully-free days per entity, and whether a required duration fits. Select entities with search/site/status (names from find_resources).

type.description: Kind of entity to check. 'site' checks every suite of sites whose name matches search.

search.description: Only entities matching this name/number/title. Omit for all.

staff.description: Staff type only: internal or external. Omit for both.

site.description: Suites only: limit to suites whose site name contains this.

days.description: Window ends this many days after start, inclusive (alternative to 'to'). Default 14.

duration_unit.description: 'minutes'/'hours' need one contiguous free slot of that length; 'days' needs that many fully-free days.

tools.name: get_my_schedule
tools.description: The calling user's own bookings in a date window (default: the next 7 days). Use it for questions like 'what is on my schedule this week'.

days.description: Window ends this many days after start, inclusive (alternative to 'to'). Default 7.

tools.name: get_my_tasks
tools.description: Tasks assigned to the calling user, with due date, priority and what they reference. Default: open tasks only.

include_done.description: Also include completed tasks. Default false.

tools.name: get_open_tasks
tools.description: All open (not yet completed) tasks of the team, with assignees, due dates and what they reference. For only the calling user's own tasks use get_my_tasks.

reference.description: Only tasks referencing this kind of entity. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_staff_projects
tools.description: List the projects a staff member is booked on, with each project's date range and duration in days.

staff_name.description: Staff member name. Partial names match; the first match is used.

tools.name: get_staff_collaborators
tools.description: Show who a staff member has worked with, based on shared bookings: each colleague with the bookings and projects they shared.

staff_name.description: Staff member name. Partial names match; the first match is used.

tools.name: get_staff_next_holiday
tools.description: Get ALL upcoming holiday blocks of a staff member plus their next work day — the day they are actually back at work, accounting for working times, shifts, public holidays and other absences. To answer 'when is X back?' always use the returned next work day; never derive it from a holiday's end date (the staff may have days off, public holidays or further absences right after it). Omit staff_name to get the calling user's own holidays.

staff_name.description: Staff member name. Partial names match; the first match is used. Omit for the calling user's own staff record.

tools.name: get_staff_holiday_quota
tools.description: Get a staff member's holiday quota for one year: total, taken and remaining days. Omit staff_name to get the calling user's own quota.

staff_name.description: Staff member name. Partial names match; the first match is used. Omit for the calling user's own staff record.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

tools.name: get_project_stats
tools.description: Booking statistics for one project: how many bookings are in the past vs upcoming, with a per-status breakdown. Also returns the project timespan: when the first booking starts, when the last booking ends (local date + time) and the duration in days between them.

project_name.description: Project name. Partial names match; the first match is used.

tools.name: get_project_team
tools.description: List the staff members who worked on a project, with each person's number of bookings on it.

project_name.description: Project name. Partial names match; the first match is used.

tools.name: get_project_tasks
tools.description: Task status of one project: all tasks on the project and its bookings, with a summary of how many are open, done and overdue.

project_name.description: Project name. Partial names match; the first match is used.

tools.name: get_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with filters and per-currency totals; paginated. Status buckets: draft, open (finalized & unpaid, includes overdue), overdue, paid, partially-paid, canceled, locked. To find a client's invoices use search — it matches number, order number, subject and recipient address.

search.description: Match number, order number, subject or recipient address.

number.description: Substring match on the invoice number.

sum_min.description: Minimum net total in major currency units (e.g. euros).

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: List offers (quotes) with filters and per-currency net totals; paginated. Status buckets: draft, locked, open (finalized, no decision yet), accepted, declined. Each offer shows how many invoices were created from it. Search matches number, order number, subject and recipient address.

search.description: Match number, order number, subject or recipient address.

number.description: Substring match on the offer number.

sum_min.description: Minimum net total in major currency units (e.g. euros).

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: List orders (jobs) with their connected offers and invoices inline; paginated. Use it for questions like 'what was quoted and billed on order X'. Search matches order number and name.

number.description: Substring match on the order number.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the freispace documentation. Returns the most relevant excerpts. Use it for questions about how freispace itself works (features, settings, how-tos).

query.description: The question or keywords to search the documentation for.
